title: Literal host contexts
description: This check finds an environment side or a phonological rule context made only of literal segments: no natural class, variable, repetition or option. A side is flagged when it spells three or more segments, or two or more segments next to a word anchor, a morpheme boundary or an affix hyphen. / # w o r d  is the shape: it limits an allomorph to one host word, which is a lexical listing written as phonology. Each finding names the environment or rule and every allomorph that uses the environment.
